ValidationRule.description: This rule does not allow any other agents Except CLAS and Collections agents to move Cases into NAS Collections Queue.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($UserRole.DeveloperName == 'CLAS_Agent'), NOT($UserRole.DeveloperName == 'Manager_Customer_Loyalty'), NOT($UserRole.DeveloperName == 'CLAS_Supervisor'), NOT($Permission.CLAS_Collection_Team), Owner:Queue.DeveloperName == 'NAS_Collections' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot move the case to NAS Collections Queue. Please select a different queue.
